# WASMOS Error / Status Codes

Two axes: **transport** (`wasmos_status_t`, the global call-mechanism result)
and **domains** (namespaced operation errors, packed as `(domain << 16) | code`).

## Transport (`wasmos_status_t`)

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `WASMOS_OK` | 0 | success |
| `WASMOS_INVAL` | -1 | invalid argument |
| `WASMOS_DENIED` | -2 | capability or policy denied the operation |
| `WASMOS_FULL` | -3 | destination queue is full |
| `WASMOS_NOENT` | -4 | no such object or endpoint |
| `WASMOS_TIMEOUT` | -5 | operation timed out |
| `WASMOS_NOMEM` | -6 | out of memory |
| `WASMOS_UNSUPPORTED` | -7 | operation not supported |
| `WASMOS_PEER_GONE` | -8 | peer process or endpoint no longer exists |
| `WASMOS_AGAIN` | -9 | retryable: resource temporarily unavailable |
